In the [[FIFA World Cup]], the following male [[Association football|football]] players have made the most final tournament appearances in matches and inclusions as squad members.

==Matches==
The following players had [[Cap (sport)|cap]]s in at least 15 FIFA World Cup tournament matches.<ref group="fr">{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/statisticsandrecords/tournaments/worldcup/players/mostmatches.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071020222327/http://fifa.com/worldfootball/statisticsandrecords/tournaments/worldcup/players/mostmatches.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=20 October 2007|title=FIFA World Cup Record: Players|website=FIFA.com|publisher=Fédération Internationale de Football Association|access-date=21 June 2014}}</ref><ref group="fr">{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co139/fifa-world-cup/records-all-time-appearances/|title=World Cup - All-time appearances|website=WorldFootball.net|access-date=16 June 2026}}</ref>
